children: European indexes jump across the continent after the Democrats' resounding win in U.S. midterm elections prompted a rally across global stocks. Banking, software and chemicals sectors are among those that rise sharply as the Stoxx Europe 600 rises 1.95%, on track for its best day since May. London's FTSE 100 is 1.9% higher. The German DAX jumps 2.5%--on track for its best day since April 2025 and closing in on a fresh high--with Deutsche Bank surging 6.35%, while Adidas jumps 4.8%. In Paris, the CAC 40 adds 2.3% to trade at highs not seen since early September. Italy's FTSE MIB jumps 2.5%, while the Spanish IBEX 35 gains 3.4%, with both indexes spurred higher by banks. The Dutch AEX gains 1.4%, even as ASML--Europe's most valuable company--falls 3.4%. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
